summary: ChipMOS Technologies filed a 6-K disclosing financial information triggered by a TWSE threshold. The filing contains unaudited monthly (Feb 2026: revenue NT$2,144M, net profit NT$86M) and audited quarterly/accumulated results. There is no transaction, activist campaign, or special corporate event. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of financials. As a foreign private issuer report, it corresponds to a US 8-K for material financial information but is not a special situation.
